main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads n pairs, canonicalizes them by axis normalization, GCD reduction, and sign adjustment, then combines perpendicular pair counts using modular powers of two and prints the final subset count modulo mod." main]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read the integer n from standard input using int(input()). RESULT n]
            [COMMAND Initialize dic as defaultdict(int), so missing keys are initialized to 0 on access, to store counts of canonicalized pair keys. RESULT dic]
            [COMMAND Initialize dic1 as defaultdict(int), so missing keys are initialized to 0 on access, to store the same counts for reverse-pair lookup. RESULT dic1]
            [COMMAND Loop exactly n times. In each iteration, read a pair (a, b) from inpm(); normalize the pair as follows: if a != 0 and b == 0, set a = 1; elif a == 0 and b != 0, set b = 1; else if both are nonzero, compute m = gcd(a, b), set a = a // m and b = b // m; if both are zero, leave the pair unchanged. Then apply sign normalization: if a < 0 and b < 0, negate both; if a < 0 and b > 0, negate both. Finally, form index = str(a) + ' ' + str(b) and increment both dic[index] and dic1[index] by 1. RESULT dic_dic1]
            [COMMAND Set ans = 1 as the starting modular product. RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND Initialize dic2 as defaultdict(int), so missing keys are initialized to 0 on access, to mark keys already processed as part of a reverse pair. RESULT dic2]
            [COMMAND Loop over each key e in dic. Parse a and b from e.split() as integers; if a == 0 or b == 0, continue to the next key. For each remaining key, set flag = 0 and construct rev: if a > 0 and b > 0, rev = str(b) + ' ' + str(-a); otherwise rev = str(-b) + ' ' + str(a). With short-circuit evaluation, if dic1[rev] > 0 and dic2[rev] == 0, set dic2[rev] = 1, dic2[e] = 1, flag = 1; if flag is set, continue to the next key. Compute n1 = pow(2, dic[e], mod) and n2 = pow(2, dic1[rev], mod). If n1 == 0, multiply ans by n2; elif n2 == 0, multiply ans by n1; else multiply ans by (n1 + n2 - 1). Then reduce ans modulo mod. RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND Set num = 0. RESULT num]
            [COMMAND Evaluate the axis-count conditional chain with short-circuit evaluation: if dic['1 0'] and dic['0 1'] are both truthy, set num = (pow(2, dic['1 0'], mod) + pow(2, dic['0 1'], mod) - 1) % mod; elif dic['1 0'] is truthy, set num = pow(2, dic['1 0'], mod) % mod; elif dic['0 1'] is truthy, set num = pow(2, dic['0 1'], mod) % mod; otherwise leave num unchanged at 0. RESULT num]
            [COMMAND If num != 0, multiply ans by num and then reduce ans modulo mod. RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND Print ans - 1 + dic['0 0'] to standard output. RESULT printed_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
